confidence_notes: Numbeo's May 2026 Chengdu averages support the restaurant, coffee, and draft-beer anchors; an Expatistan Chengdu entry updated 18 October 2026 supports the cocktail estimate. Wine is estimated at roughly three local draft beers because a representative restaurant glass price was unavailable. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates from general knowledge and are less certain; no current lodging listings were checked. The price-index data is crowd-sourced.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was needed: Chengdu price observations anchor food and drinks, while accommodation is a holistic estimate for the city's budget-to-midrange urban market.
